about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: Version 1 (candidate). Written from 12 stock goldfish games (seeds 28001-28012). Stock takes every miracle it is offered (27 of 27 triggers cast), so the miracle draw itself needs no rule. What stock leaves undone: the commander waits behind other plays (first cast on own turns 3 to 14), and several creatures are never cast at all in goldfish (Fear of Sleep Paralysis 7 games drawn, 0 cast; Dream Eater 6/0; Phenomenon Investigators 4/0; Doomwake Giant 3/0), nor are the Rooms from hand. Rules: Sol Ring, then Aminatou the turn she is affordable, then rocks; the enchantment engine (cost reducer, Mesa Enchantress, Sigil, Secret Arcade which makes every permanent an enchantment for Sigil and Mesa); Entreat from hand at the largest X of two or more; the bodies Forge sits on; unlock Rooms; card selection guarded by library size; Hall of Heliod's Generosity after combat to put an enchantment on top for the next turn's miracle. Answers (wipes, removal, counters, Inkshield) left to Forge.
